title: Preflight what the engine can read: per-CV text check and a blind-mode guard
deviations_from_card: Write set grew only by perf-budget.json (shared surface, under the lock): app/page.tsx ceiling 1382/8645 -> 1385/8664 for this card's +3 modules / ~19 KB. Added beyond the card, all fail-closed tightenings: (1) an 'unreadable' CV (extractor 4xx) is also treated as unmaskable under blind and blocks with the same remedies; (2) verdict.waiting - while blind is on and a CV is still 'checking', the Analyze button waits for the check instead of letting a possibly-unmaskable document through (an 'unchecked' result still never blocks); (3) an 'unreadable' JD file gets a note; (4) unchecked results are never cached (retried on the next look). Test file carries a 9th case (8b: network throw -> unchecked, not cached) beside the card's 8. No change to AnalyzeApi.ts, useAnalyzeForm.ts, useAnalyzeCvFiles.ts or AnalyzeTab.tsx.
